title: ABI-CDMs: Amortized Bayesian Inference of Conflict Diffusion Models
description: ABI-CDMs provides the release-ready pipeline for amortized Bayesian inference (neural simulation-based inference) of four conflict diffusion models—the Diffusion Decision Model (DDM), the Diffusion Model for Conflict (DMC), the Shrinking Spotlight (SSP), and the Dual-Stage Two-Phase (DSTP) model—along with the constrained and dRiftDM-aligned specifications reported in the supplementary material. It accompanies the manuscript 'No Single Model Fits All: Conflict Decision-Making Models Vary More Across Studies Than Across Tasks.' The repository includes preprocessing, training, fitting, validation, model-comparison, posterior-predictive-check, factor-analysis, and robustness scripts, plus a reusable inference library (nsbi_module) and the nine retained raw datasets. Pretrained estimator checkpoints are archived separately (Zenodo: 10.5281/zenodo.21623907).
